{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Juggernaut Core{/c} Skills are empowered, dealing {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage to the first enemy hit and storing the damage dealt to that target, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} times.
